messages:
sam: Heads up — us-west-2 host group 'pool-dedicated-1' is hitting thermal-triggered PCIe throttles, about 12 nodes auto-evicted in the last 10m. Sticky allocations kept traffic in the same AZ so routing couldn't fallback. We're seeing 99p latency jump and egress queueing on the edge proxies.
priya: Ugh. Do we have a short-lived mitigation? Can we force cross-az-reshuffle or disable sticky_alloc for that pool?
marco: I'm looking at allocator logs now. Sticky allocs flag is still on for several critical slices. We can flip it per-pool but need a coordinated rollout or we'll churn cold-starts.
taylor: If we flip sticky_alloc it'll create cold starts but better than ongoing throttles. Suggest: flip for pool-dedicated-1 only + bump warm-pool size to absorb canaries.
ops-bot: /alert host-thermal us-west-2 pool-dedicated-1 nodes_evicted=12 severity=warning
sam: Short term plan: 1) Disable sticky_alloc on pool-dedicated-1 for 15m 2) Increase warm-pool target by +3 for the pool 3) Route dedicated tenant fallback to eu-west if cross-az fallback triggered. Can someone run the change?
marco: I'll make the change to the allocator config. Patch (dry-run first):
```json
PATCH /allocator/v1/pools/pool-dedicated-1
{ "sticky_alloc": false, "warm_pool_target": 3 }
```
I will dry-run then apply if no red flags in 60s.
priya: Also, we should throttle egress at the proxy level to avoid head-of-line congestion. 99p token latency is coming from egress stalls. Suggest: apply soft egress cap 800Mbps for that AZ for 10m.
taylor: I'll push a proxy route tweak: add egress-cap-limit: 800mbps for us-west-2/pool-dedicated-1 in the route table.
ops-bot: /action allocator-dryrun id=run_4987654321_dry result=started
sam: Quick cost note: if this spills to canary-fallback and we route many requests to eu-west, cross-region egress will spike — finance FYI. But better than tenant SLA hits.
marco: After dry-run: allocator dry-run OK, no immediate pack/unpack churn predicted. Applying now.
marco: applied. sticky_alloc=false, warm_pool_target=3. Watching metrics.
priya: Proxy throttle applied. Egress queues dropping by ~40% in the graphs.
taylor: Routing policy updated to prefer region fallback after allocator fallback. Will watch latencies.
sam: Observing 99p latency down ~30% and evictions stabilizing. Still seeing a couple thermal-surge hosts, ops asked infra to schedule a maintenance window.
marco: For the longer term we should: add thermal_score to host scoring, widen allocator smoothing window, and stop permanent sticky defaults for dedicated slices. I'll open a design PR with perf/cost estimate.
priya: +1. Also add an alert for cross-az-sticky-fallback rate so we detect when routing can't rebalance.
taylor: I'll draft the alert and a playbook entry: "thermal surge -> disable sticky_alloc on impacted pool -> proxy egress cap -> monitor 10m -> escalate to maintenance".
sam: Solid. Thanks team. Will follow up in the oncall runbook with timeline and cost impact. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: /note maintenance-ticket #MNT-834 created: cooling vendor engaged, tentative start 2026-05-12 02:00 UTC
marco: PR: github.com/redwood-inference/allocator/pull/912 (design + cost calc). Assigning to @sam for review.
priya: Let's also tag budget owners for cross-region egress (cc @finance).
sam: ok, looping finance. Closing temporary thread — will update when maintenance window confirmed.
